description.en: Computes the distance, horizontal angle and vertical angle from a reference point to a target position — the inverse of GetDistRotCameraPos. Returns a fixed fallback [100.0, 0.0, 0.0] when the two points are extremely close together (an underflow guard in the distance check).
3-element array [x, y, z] with the target position.
3-element array [x, y, z] with the reference point.
A 3-element array [distance, horizontalAngleDeg, verticalAngleDeg]; a fixed [100.0, 0.0, 0.0] fallback if the two points are effectively coincident.

examples.case: Computing distance/angle between a camera's current position and reference point (real call pattern, from sysCamCtrlStep; position values here are illustrative)
